UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile document containing preferred username and account metadata.

username.description: Preferred display name and username of the user.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the profile was last modified.

Chat.title: Chat
Chat.description: A conversation thread owned by an authenticated user.

id.description: Unique identifier of the chat conversation.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the chat was initiated.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent message in the chat.

isPinned.description: Whether the user pinned this conversation to the top.

pinnedAt.description: Timestamp when the chat was pinned.

isImported.description: Whether this conversation was imported from a shared chat snapshot. Defaults to false for ordinary conversations.

importedFromShareId.description: Unique shareId of the shared conversation snapshot from which this conversation was imported, or null for ordinary conversations.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: An individual message within a conversation subcollection.

id.description: Unique stable identifier for the message.

modelUsed.description: Identifier of the AI model that produced the message if applicable.

provider.description: AI provider identifier that generated the response if applicable.

responseTimeMs.description: Response generation latency in milliseconds for assistant messages.

parentMessageId.description: Identifier of the preceding user message that triggered an assistant response.

interactionId.description: Shared interaction identifier pairing a user prompt and assistant response.

activeAlternativeId.description: Identifier of the currently active alternative response on an assistant message.

alternatives.description: Sanitized alternative responses generated across providers or models.

attachments.description: Sanitized metadata and extracted document/OCR text for user attachments (excluding raw binary blobs or base64 data).

referencedAttachments.description: Sanitized attachment references used as context for assistant responses.

createdAtMs.description: Deterministic client epoch timestamp in milliseconds for chronological ordering.

clientTimestamp.description: Formatted local timestamp for immediate display.

UserSettings.title: UserSettings
UserSettings.description: User personalization preferences including theme, response style, composer settings, and display flags.

enterToSend.description: Whether pressing Enter in composer submits the message.

showTimestamps.description: Whether to display timestamps on chat messages.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when settings were last modified.

SharedChat.title: SharedChat
SharedChat.description: An immutable, sanitized public snapshot of a deliberately shared conversation containing no private owner identifiers.

id.description: Unique unguessable share identifier matching the sharedChats/{shareId} document ID.

title.description: Sanitized display title of the shared conversation.

mode.description: Conversation mode at the time the snapshot was shared.

createdAt.description: Firestore server timestamp when the shared snapshot was created.

messageCount.description: Total number of messages included in the shared snapshot, matching messages.length.

messages.description: Ordered array of sanitized user and assistant messages.

id.description: Stable message identifier within the snapshot.

content.description: Plain text or markdown content of the message.

modelUsed.description: AI model identifier for assistant messages, or null.

provider.description: AI provider identifier for assistant messages, or null.

mode.description: Optional conversation mode under which the message was generated.

responseTimeMs.description: Generation duration in milliseconds for assistant responses, or null.

parentMessageId.description: ID of the triggering user message for assistant responses, or null.

interactionId.description: Shared turn identifier pairing a user prompt and its assistant response.

activeAlternativeId.description: Currently selected alternative response ID for assistant messages.

alternatives.description: Sanitized history of alternative responses generated for an assistant turn.

attachments.description: Sanitized attachment metadata and extracted text/OCR content (no binary blobs, base64, or data URLs).

extraction.description: Sanitized document/image text extraction metadata and extracted text.

referencedAttachments.description: Sanitized attachment metadata referenced by an assistant response.

createdAtMs.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds preserving chronological message ordering.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user profile and preferred username for the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/settings/{settingId}.description: Stores personalization preferences and settings for the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Stores conversation metadata for each authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}/messages/.description: Subcollection holding chronological messages belonging to a specific conversation.

/sharedChats/{shareId}.description: Top-level collection holding deliberately published, immutable, sanitized conversation snapshots accessible by exact shareId.
